meta.title: The bid count matches the bids listed
gaps: The plan verifies the expected bid count and that both bid records can be read, but cannot dynamically compare bid_count with a returned list length because no operation lists all bids or supports cross-field assertions.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “bid count” equals 2.
As the buyer, read the bid and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
As the buyer, read the second QA vendor's bid and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “bid count” equals 2; Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked); Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
